svg.title: Pure Quint visibility evaluation pipeline
svg.desc: A bounded visibility query expands footprints into cell pairs, checks pair and work limits, sends each pair through canonical supercover terrain and sampled boundary predicates, counts visible samples, and returns a consistent result record.
svg.text: PURE EVALUATOR / data in, result out

rect.title: VisibilityQuery contains origin and target anchors, a relative footprint set, disclosed opaque cell and edge sets, and maximumCrossedItems.
tracePairs translates the footprint at both anchors and forms their Cartesian product; pair count is checked before tracing.
lineVisible is a conjunction: internal canonical supercover cells must pass terrain transparency and reported sampled-line edges must pass boundary permeability.
visibleSampleCount folds every admitted footprint pair, adding one exactly when lineVisible returns true.
VisibilityResult reports existential visibility, visible and total sample counts, declared and diagnostic work, and whether evaluation was truncated.

path.title: Expansion boundary: convert query anchors and footprint offsets into absolute source-target cell pairs.
Admission boundary: continue only when footprint and declared crossed-item limits permit evaluation.
Predicate boundary: each pair contributes one Boolean visibility sample after both blocker checks.
Result boundary: visible is true exactly when the query is not truncated and at least one sample is visible.

g.text: No mutable production state is invented: the simulation module stores this pure result only to exercise invariants and reachability witnesses.
